handling.promotion: A failed or guard-terminated attempt promotes no ROOT file.
handling.retry: A missing logical slot is regenerated with a new deterministic seed derived from campaign, tune, logical job, and attempt.
handling.analysis: Only promoted complete outputs named by the sealed canonical manifest enter reduction.
handling.reporting: Attempt attrition is disclosed as measured and is not corrected away or converted into an event weight.

interpretation: This accepts the recorded approximately-six-percent CR campaign attrition. It is not a universal tolerance for future campaigns; a materially different rate or failure mechanism requires a new recorded decision.
evidence_origin: pre-rebuild adversarial-remediation amendment, 2026-08-21; record held in the internal repository
